bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Unbeaten R3 Petit Poucet Metz ESAP tests R1 leaders Reipertswiller.

spf.comment: Covers both Reipertswiller's R1 class edge in a 0:2 away win and Metz ESAP's proven low-block route to a 1:1 draw, as unconfirmed lineups and prior R1 giant-killing make a single Away Win too narrow.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.25 total lambda, 60.9% Poisson under-2.5 density, and recent clean-sheet cup wins for both clubs.

score.comment: 0:2 mirrors Reipertswiller's back-to-back 2:0 victories over Hoerdt and Forbach, while 1:1 reflects the top Poisson cell if Metz ESAP scores on transition.

goals.comment: Two goals (26.7%) and one goal (23.7%) represent the highest-probability buckets in the 2.25-lambda Poisson distribution.

bqc.comment: Metz ESAP's compact home structure can keep the first half level before Reipertswiller's R1 depth tells late or the hosts hold out for 90 minutes.
